## Outcome and ownership

State the observable result. Link its parent capability and name the owner and
reviewer. Leave missing assignments explicit.

## Starting point and scope

Link current source, relevant requirements and exact fixtures. Name dependencies,
open decisions and the boundary of this task. Distinguish simulation from hardware.

## Acceptance and checks

Declare pass conditions before execution and preserve existing gates. Give the
focused test or experiment command, including a relevant failure case.

## Completion

Link the PR and evidence with source/model/input identities. Record checks and
remaining limits. Follow `CONTRIBUTING.md` for publication; a completed experiment
can establish a failed result while its parent capability stays open.
